*CS435 - GDB Solution By Saif Chishti*

*Recommended Technique:* Horizontal Scaling

I would recommend using Horizontal Scaling for ShopEase because it allows the company to add more virtual machines with the same hardware configuration and distribute incoming requests among them.

It helps manage increased website traffic efficiently by sharing the workload and allows the company to add or remove virtual machines according to demand which improves website performance and flexibility.
